contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C POSTVMVS P[ F AVG] ; R/ [VICTOR]IA AVG

A copper-alloy radiate of Postumus (AD 260-269); dating to c.AD 260-269. VICTORIA AVG reverse. Cunetio 2369-2370. Obverse description: Radiate, (cuirassed) bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C POSTVMVS P[ F AVG]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm; captive at foot. Reverse inscription: [VICTOR]IA AVG. Diameter: 23.82 mm; Thickness: 1.78 mm; Weight: 3.89g
